services.desc: For decades, Skydive DeLand has been part of the foundation of modern skydiving, a place where training, community, and industry have come together to shape the sport. From its early days through years of growth under the leadership of Bob Hallett, DeLand became known not just as a dropzone, but as a gathering place for skydivers at every level. Skydive DeLand is known for its long-standing role in the skydiving community, its connection to parachute manufacturing and training development, and its history of supporting skydivers at all levels.
